resources.string: Today\'s cards against your goal; the red seal once it is met. Resize it to a slim bar or a small pill.
Your streak and the grace shields left this month, in a row 1 to 4 columns wide.
Your streak, this week day by day, the shields and your best: one column wide, two or three rows tall.
Review the card you are closest to forgetting, right here.
The day at a glance: your goal seal, how the answers went, your streak and how well you remember.
Study, Daily mix, New card and Search, one tap away. 1 to 4 columns.
Four buttons: Study, Daily mix, New card and Search.
Your study heatmap: five weeks in 2 columns, up to sixteen in 4. Today wears a ring.
How many cards start slipping each day if you do not study: two weeks, in 2 or 3 rows.
Your tier, name and four numbers. Tap to turn the card over.
A card you know cold, prompt and answer, new every few hours.
Your latest wax seals, each turning, and the one you are closest to. 3 or 4 columns.
Your deck bars with their progress fans. Tap one to study it.
